programme.title: Lost Treasures of The Maya
programme.desc: Albert Lin spent many months in the Guatemalan jungle in the company of an international team of scientists.He recorded material at twelve major archaeological sites.The researchers had at their disposal a LiDAR device that works similarly to an X-ray.It allowed the terrain to be scanned from the air.Thanks to this, a digital map was developed.A special application was also created showing the local landscape without forests.Therefore, there was no need to cut down the trees.Objects that were part of previously unknown cities were found, including pyramids and a fortified citadel.They also found the skeleton of the queen, the ruler's burial chamber with richly decorated ritual vessels, fragments of the skull of a sacrificed child, bas-reliefs, a stone altar, a painted vase, as well as dozens of statuettes and ceramic objects.The discoveries made allowed us to re-evaluate the current knowledge about the Mayan civilization.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of the world of U.S. fighter pilotsNavy.Viewers will learn about preparations for the start of combat missions and exams.Sometimes dreams collide with reality and not everyone manages to survive the technically demanding training.The cameras were installed, among others,in the cockpit of the machines to see for yourself what bombing exercises look like.Candidates face impressive speeds and overloads.Sometimes physical limitations prove to be an insurmountable obstacle.In such conditions, it's easy to make a mistake, you really need to have nerves of steel.One of the key skills is precise landing on an aircraft carrier.Cadets also practice direct combat.To complete this stage, you need to defeat your own mentor and score a "hit" while avoiding the crosshair yourself.On the ground, there will be briefings conducted by demanding instructors.There are many difficult moments when you doubt and lose faith in your own abilities.At the end there is a week of truth.The daredevils then have one last chance to earn the prestigious badge.
